column8: Char. E'en as the o'erflowing Nilus
Iras. Am I not an inch
His brother warr'd upon him; although,
Eno. That truth should be silent
Mec. She's a most triumphant lady,
Ant. Come, sir, come; I'll wrestle
I' the posture of a whore.
